description: Two-column horizontal post cards with cover thumb, date, author, and excerpt.

files.content:
import type * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import hacksWatch from "./images/hacks-watch.webp" import imagination from "./images/imagination.webp" import prediction from "./images/prediction.webp" import teamImage from "./images/team-image.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const DEFAULT_POSTS = [ { id: 1, image: assetSrc(imagination), title: "A Guide to Igniting Your Imagination", date: "10 FEB 2023", author: "JOHN DOE", description: "Explore simple ways to spark your creativity and bring ideas to life. Perfect for artists, writers, and dreamers.", href: "#", }, { id: 2, image: assetSrc(hacksWatch), title: "Hacks to Supercharge Your Day", date: "7 JUN 2023", author: "MARK ADAIR", description: "Boost productivity with smart, time-saving tips. Small changes can make a big impact on your routine.", href: "#", }, { id: 3, image: assetSrc(prediction), title: "Trends and Predictions", date: "5 OCT 2023", author: "SIMON KONECKI", description: "Discover what’s next in the world of design, tech, and lifestyle. Stay ahead of the curve with expert insights.", href: "#", }, { id: 4, image: assetSrc(teamImage), title: "Innovators Changing the Game", date: "10 DEC 2023", author: "SIMON KONECKI", description: "Meet the minds reshaping industries with bold ideas and fresh thinking. Be inspired by real change-makers.", href: "#", }, ] export type BlogPost = { id: number image: string title: string date: string author: string description: string href: string } export default function Blog({ eyebrow = "Dispatch", title = "Latest Blog Posts", description = "Explore our latest articles, insights, and practical tips designed to help you stay updated, improve your workflow, and build better products with confidence.", posts = DEFAULT_POSTS, className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section"> & { eyebrow?: string title?: string description?: string posts?: BlogPost[] }) { return (

{eyebrow}

{title}

{description}

{posts.map((post) => (

{post.date} · {post.author}

{post.title}

{post.description}

))}
) }
